retrievalProfile.description: A surreal 1960s-style composition featuring a group of subjects on a rocky beach with ghostly double-exposed silhouettes and high-contrast serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dreamlike coastal scene where a central group of figures is surrounded by translucent, ethereal silhouettes of themselves. The image uses a muted, warm-toned palette and is topped with bold, overlapping typography that anchors the upper third of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Sharp foreground subjects against soft, blurred background ghosts
Warm earthy tones of the rocks and clothing against a desaturated sky
Large-scale serif typography overlapping a smaller secondary line of text
Horizontal division between the dark rocky shore and the hazy horizon
coreInvariants: Double exposure effect on background figures
High-contrast white and muted red typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five men positioned in the lower two-thirds, varying in height and pose across a rocky shoreline.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white serif title in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold white text, moves down to the central standing figure, and then fans out to the ghostly silhouettes in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The hazy, overcast sky provides a neutral backdrop for the upper text elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and ochres of the rocks and clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dusty rose for secondary text and stark white for primary title
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the typography.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing with occasional overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' and 'L' in the main title are tightly kerned to touch
Roman numerals are used for numbering
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with a low-contrast sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Small technical metadata block in the top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, sharp serif aesthetic of the 60s/70s.
Appropriate for the secondary lowercase text block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a group of men in 1960s attire (turtlenecks, slacks) on a rocky beach at dusk. Use a double exposure effect to create translucent, ghostly silhouettes of the men standing in the background. Apply a muted, warm film-grain filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white high-contrast serif title in the upper left. Above it, add a smaller line of lowercase sans-serif text in a muted red color. Place a small technical text block in the upper right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main title in a high-contrast serif font?
Is the color palette muted and earthy?
Is there a visible film grain texture?

mustRedesign: Do not use vibrant primary colors
Ensure text does not have modern effects like glows or bevels
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surreal Double Exposure Photography] + [1960s Earthy Color Grade] + [High-Contrast Serif Display Typography] to create a vintage psychedelic aesthetic.
